title: LoadStrike microbenchmark harness for tokens/sec rhythm and p95 guard
creator: Aarav Patel
description:
Goal: Build a stable, low-noise microbenchmark harness (LoadStrike) that measures tokens/sec behavior and p95 tail latency for core models across representative shapes and runtime configs. The harness should power fast PR smoke checks, nightly full-matrix runs, and an automated regression detector that can trigger bisect jobs and PagerDuty alerts.

Scope:
- Implement a reproducible workload generator that runs against the serving runtime and Redwood API (hosted and Dedicated-compatible runners).
- Support three canonical shapes: short (<=32 tokens), medium (128-512 tokens), long (>=1024 tokens).
- Vary batch sizes (1, 4, 8, 16), concurrency (1..8), and kv-warmup states (cold, warmed prefix).
- Measure: tokens/sec (aggregate and per-shard), p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU/GPU utilization, and model-variant delta (fp16 vs int8 quantized).
- Low-cost signal tiering: lightweight per-PR smoke (3 min, 3 shapes) + nightly exhaustive run across core models.

Deliverables:
- Reusable harness code in infra/benchmarks/loadstrike with CLI and GitHub Actions integration.
- CI smoke job that runs on critical PRs (flags in CODEOWNERS-enabled areas).
- Nightly job that writes time-series to metrics store and populates a dashboard in Console (per-model route, per-shape).
- Regression detector rules with thresholds and a playbook for triage and automated bisect.

Non-goals: full e2e user simulation, token-level correctness evals (separate eval infra).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Smoke job runs in <5m for PRs and logs tokens/sec and p95 to CI; 2) Nightly full matrix completes within allotted budget and uploads metrics to metrics-store; 3) Regression detector fires when tokens/sec drops >10% relative to 28-day baseline or p95 increases >15% and creates an incident ticket with diagnostic artifacts; 4) Bisect job can re-run a narrowed set of commits and model variants automatically; 5) Console dashboard shows live per-model tokens/sec and p95 panels with historical overlays.
comments: 2025-02-13 - initial design sketched; decided to separate smoke vs nightly tiers to balance cost and sensitivity. (Aarav)
2025-02-18 - architecture review: SRE requested retention of raw samples for 7 days and aggregated metrics for 90 days. Added requirement to export sample traces for failing runs. (Maya)
2025-02-25 - prototype CLI implemented for a single model; measured high variance on long-shape runs. Introduced synthetic jitter averaging (n=5) and bootstrapped median to reduce noise. (Maya)

2025-02-28 - PR #12803 created for harness library; awaiting infra review. Noted tradeoff: increasing runs reduces false positives but increases GPU cost. Recommendation: fast smoke (3 iterations) + nightly deep (10 iterations). (Code review by Priya)

2025-03-02 - Regression thresholds proposal: tokens/sec drop >10% (relative) or absolute p95 >500ms or p95 increase >15% triggers alert. SRE requested a secondary check that validates under cold vs warm KV conditions. (SRE review)

2025-03-04 - Integrated initial CI workflow; early runs show quantized model (int8) has 8% better tokens/sec but 12% higher p95 on long tails. Flagged for follow-up to add variant comparison view on dashboard. (Maya)
Next steps: land PR with infra fixes, add PagerDuty integration, and enable nightly runs for baseline collection.
